prerequisites: The ability to program in a high-level programming language
Basic concepts about computer networks and operating systems

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to apply architectural patterns, design patterns, and best practices in the field to design highly complex software applications.
The student has appropriate knowledge related to the use of integrated development environments for creating large-scale complex applications.
The student has the ability to understand and use design patterns for application development.
The student has the ability to develop, design, and create new applications, systems, or products using best practices in the field.
The student has the necessary skills to understand and use object-oriented programming concepts in the development of medium-complexity software applications.
The student has the ability to apply general rules to specific problems and produce relevant solutions.
The student is able to combine diverse information to formulate solutions and generate development ideas for new products and applications.

The student knows multiple programming languages and is capable of writing applications in compiled, interpreted, or dynamic languages, having the ability to choose the appropriate programming language for the specifics of the application being developed.

syllabus_topics: Build automation, dependency management; version control systems
assessment_rules: Successfully passing the examination is conditioned by a minimum grade of 5 for each of the following: practical examination, written examination and project. Students must attend the written and practical exams during the normal or resit session. For participating at the examination attendance is compulsory for project and for laboratory activities, as follows: minimum 5 attendances for project and minimum 12 attendances for laboratory activities. The practical exam consists of several iterative stages in which students are given requirements step by step and are required to build an application accordingly.
